author: Andrew Fisher
scope: Independent read-only visual inspection of two native phone orientation screenshots and their recorded layout metrics. No browser rerun or source changes.
result: PASS for this layout review only
observations: At 320 x 700 the actual engine remains visible above a separate orange-bordered bench tray. Cycle phase buttons, the focused range slider, Overview, Lift and Exit remain legible. Additional tray controls use internal scrolling.

At 844 x 390 the actual engine remains visible to the left of the bench tray. Header navigation and action controls fit inside the viewport. The focused range control has a clear inset orange outline without obscuring its label.
Both screenshots preserve the Coates orange and dark workshop appearance. Model and tray do not overlap.
Native metrics record document width equal to client width in both orientations, no horizontal overflow, and page scrollY zero.
limitations: The full native acceptance suite was still ongoing when this review was written; this report is not a full-suite or publication verdict.
Images were captured with headless Chromium software rendering (SwiftShader). Displayed frame-rate readings are not physical-device performance evidence.
This review confirms layout and control visibility. It does not claim production deployment or independent live read-back.
